check_ipex_available: check if the intel_extension_for_pytorch package is installed using is_ipex_available
get_cuda_free_memory: get the free CUDA GPU memory for a device with a given memory fraction
get_xpu_free_memory: get the free XPU memory for a device respecting the XPU_MEMORY_FRACTION env var
get_cpu_free_memory: get the available CPU memory divided by WORLD_SIZE using psutil
detect_system_and_bind_ops: detect the hardware system and bind empty_cache synchronize and get_free_memory to the correct backend
